stronger_left_out.name: Todd Mall
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 2/3: a pedestrian shopping street; its draws (Adelaide House, markets) are covered separately.

stronger_left_out.name: Heavitree Gap
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1-3: described in Wikivoyage's geography text only, not as a stop; a gap the highway passes through.

stronger_left_out.name: Alice Springs School of the Air
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1: Wikivoyage names it ('Famous!') and it runs visitor tours, but it shares one complex with the RFDS base listed as a single Wikivoyage entry. Skeptic: For: separate tour and famous outback institution (2310 views). Against: near-duplicate of the RFDS complex entry, which the guide treats as one place.

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Ebenezer Roadhouse
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 2: a roadhouse with basic accommodation; the art room is a side feature.

stronger_left_out.name: The Residency
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1-2: one Wikivoyage listing, museum house, volunteer-run with limited hours. Skeptic: For: 1927 heritage house open inside as a museum. Against: single source, small and limited opening, a 30-minute visit at best.

stronger_left_out.name: Ruby Gap Nature Park
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1/2: one Wikivoyage mention of a 4WD-only park with a gorge and ruby-rush history. Skeptic: For: scenic remote gorge, 963 views. Against: 4WD-only, one source, rarely visited.

stronger_left_out.name: Jay Creek Waterhole
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1: Tourism NT names it as a permanent waterhole beside the Larapinta Trail. Skeptic: For: a named permanent waterhole in a national park. Against: one source, on the Larapinta Trail rather than a destination of its own, little reason to stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Stuart Town Gaol
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1-2: Tourism NT and the National Trust list it, but it is open only limited weekday hours with keys collected from Hartley Street School and a closed summer. Skeptic: For: Alice's oldest surviving building, Tourism NT page. Against: access is by key deposit, tiny, short visit.

stronger_left_out.name: Central Australian Aviation Museum
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1: one Wikivoyage mention ('a number of older planes') beside the School of the Air. Skeptic: For: open aircraft collection with a town-reliant-on-aviation story. Against: single source, a short visit, shares the RFDS/School of the Air complex.

stronger_left_out.name: Strehlow Research Centre
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1-2: no visitor-oriented source; Wikipedia only, and the Museum of Central Australia that houses it is closed to the public, access by researcher appointment only.

stronger_left_out.name: Honeymoon Gap
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1/3: Wikivoyage names it as a turnoff on the Bullen Road loop; Nature Park with a waterhole and picnic area. Skeptic: For: a named scenic gap with swimming/waterhole and Larapinta Trail access. Against: single source that is only a turnoff mention, minor next to Simpsons Gap and Standley Chasm.

stronger_left_out.name: Hartley Street School
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1-2: Tourism NT and Discover Central Australia list it as a National Trust museum (School of the Air's first broadcast studio); hours Mon-Fri only. Skeptic: For: genuine museum, free to enter with $5 ticket. Against: no counted source in the candidate list, small, 30 minutes.

stronger_left_out.name: Wallace Rockhole
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage names the Aboriginal community with cultural tours and camping, via a 4WD side track. Skeptic: For: a guided cultural experience. Against: single source, visits need booking and community access, short sealed-road reach is disputed.

stronger_left_out.name: Illamurta Springs Conservation Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: What qualifies: Rule 1-3: a remote reserve on a 4WD route with a camp; one Tourism NT mention with no description of anything to see.

benchmark: Region has no NZ benchmark places. Spirit held: Uluru and Kata Tjuta, Kings Canyon, Standley Chasm, Simpsons Gap, Ormiston and Chambers Pillar kept; commercial/operator/event items (Sounds of Silence, Camels operators, markets, Pioneer Park Racecourse, Gallery of Central Australia shop, roadhouses) rejected; Alice Springs Markets (alternate Sundays) rejected as an event; gateway Wallace Rockhole and remote 4WD Ruby Gap held in review. Note: every stronger-than-lowest candidate is left out for a concrete What-qualifies reason; the lowest kept spots (0 views, 1-2 counted sources) are walks, lookouts and the Cultural Centre backed by Wikivoyage/Parks Australia pages.
counts_note: 55 kept; 43 are spots of 5 proposed destinations, 9 standalone, 3 kept parks are the proposed destinations themselves.
